strings.Value: At 1st level, an ecclesitheurge makes a vow to his deity to be protected solely by his faith, not by armor or shields. An ecclesitheurge who wears armor or uses a shield is unable to use his blessing of the faithful ability, use cleric domain powers, or cast cleric spells.

At 1st level, an ecclesitheurge makes a vow to his deity to be protected solely by his faith, not by armor or shields. An ecclesitheurge who wears armor or uses a shield is unable to cast cleric spells.

This creature moves with incredible speed. It gains a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor, +4 bonus to all {g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}ability scores{/g} and +10 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g}, +30 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}speed{/g}, extra {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} with full {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}BAB{/g}, Evasion and Uncanny Dodge abilities, it cannot be {g|Encyclopedia:Flanking}flanked{/g} and it is always under the effect of the {g|SpellsBlur}blur{/g} spell.

At 16th level, a winter child sacrifices a part of her soul to let a great blizzard spirit into the material world. Her blizzard servant gains the following benefits: Huge {g|Encyclopedia:Size}size{/g}, +4 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g}, +6 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g}, +4 bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g}, +2 natural armor bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}, the numbing cold ability, and cold {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}resistance{/g} 30. If the Winter Child already has an animal companion, it only receives half the bonuses and does not increase in size. In addition, whenever an ally hits an enemy affected by the blizzard servant's whirlwind of hail ability, that enemy takes an additional {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g}. Numbing cold: Whenever the blizzard elemental or an animal companion deals {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g} to a creature, that creature must succeed at a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g} (DC 10 + 1/2 level + {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} modifier) or be {g|ConditionStaggered}staggered{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.

Whenever the blizzard elemental or an animal companion deals {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g} to a creature, that creature must succeed at a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g} (DC 10 + 1/2 level + {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} modifier) or be {g|ConditionStaggered}staggered{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.

At 4th level, a winter child forms a bond with a blizzard elemental. This ability functions like the druid's animal companion ability, except that the winter child's effective druid level is equal to her druid level –3 and she can only select a blizzard elemental as her companion. This companion can't be used as a mount. This replaces wild shape. Blizzard elemental stats: {g|Encyclopedia:Size}Size{/g}: Small {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}Speed{/g}: 100 ft. {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}: +3 natural armor {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}Attacks{/g}: spike ({g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}piercing{/g}) {g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}Ability scores{/g}: {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Str{/g} 14, {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dex{/g} 16, {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Con{/g} 11, {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Int{/g} 3, {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wis{/g} 14, {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Cha{/g} 8 Whirlwind of Hail: A blizzard servant can transform itself into a whirlwind and back again. The whirlwind has a diameter of 40 feet. A creature in whirlwind form cannot make its normal {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attacks{/g} and does not {g|Encyclopedia:Threatened_Area}threaten{/g} the area around it. Creatures caught in the whirlwind take a –4 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g} and a –2 penalty on attack rolls and must succeed on a {g|Encyclopedia:Concentration}concentration{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}check{/g} ({g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} 15 + {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} level) to cast a spell. An affected creature must succeed on a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Reflex save{/g} (DC 10 + half the blizzard servant's level + its {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} modifier) each {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g} or take {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}bludgeoning{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} as if it were hit by the blizzard servant's spike attack. Blizzard Incarnate: A blizzard elemental is immune to the effects of whirlwind of hail (except for the {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} dealt by another elemental) and any natural snowstorms.
